book.pvz.pvz_guide.boss.edgar.edgar1.tex: Edgar-090505 and Edgar-09017 are robots created by Dr.Edgar, they can be summoned by challenge envelope.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.boss.edgar.edgar2.tex: Edgar Robots's common attack is its ice and fire balls. Ice balls can only be destroyed by jalapeno, and fire balls can only be destroyed by cold ice shroom. In addition, it will summon almost **all kinds of invading zombies**, especially bungee zombies, so please be careful.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.boss.edgar.name: Edgar Robot
book.pvz.pvz_guide.boss.name: Boss
book.pvz.pvz_guide.intro.card.card1.text: Summon Card is the link between players and creatures. Players can summon the corresponding creature by right click Summon Card on the ground while consuming SunNum (some cards is right-clicking the water surface). Currently, the only kind of creature that can be summoned by Summon Card is plant type (zombies may be added in later updates).
book.pvz.pvz_guide.intro.card.card2.text: There is an unlocking mechanism for summon card, and many cards are not unlocked when the player's tree level is insufficient. Unlock paths are upgrades, challenge rewards or command. Summon card is After player use card to summon a creature, the creature will treat the player as its owner.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.intro.card.card3.text:
Maximum stack size: 1
Can enchant
Long CoolDown
Unlimited use
The color of card frame is related to its rank.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.intro.card.card4.text:
Maximum stack size: 16
Can't enchant
1s CoolDown
Can only be used once
The color of card frame is wood.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.intro.card.card5.text: After 0.6 version, the card placement becomes more strict. Only 50 plants can be planted within 30 blocks, after that every 5 more sun cost will be doubled. Densely planting enchantment can slow down this situation.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.intro.card.card6.text: The previous two pages introduced the difference between Common Summon Cards and Enjoy Cards, and their acquisition is actually different. Common Cards are generally obtained by crafting or purchase, while Enjoy Cards are often obtained by opening treasure chests or lottery or finish invasion.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.intro.card.name: Summon Card
book.pvz.pvz_guide.intro.description: Here will introduce some basic information of the Plants vs Zombies mod, so that players can better understand this mod.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.intro.difficulty.diff: If you play in hard mode, there will have no Safe Day at the beginning. What's more, invasion and challenge will be much harder.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.intro.difficulty.name: Difficulty
book.pvz.pvz_guide.intro.group.group1.te: This world is divided into 5 groups, respectively, other hostile(-2), zombies(-1), neutral(0), plants(1), other guards(2). Players are initially set as plants, and this option can be changed in the config file. Also players can change groups through the /playerstats command.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.intro.group.group2.te: Monsters other than zombies are in other hostile groups, such as skeletons and creepers. Guards other than plants are in other guards groups, such as iron golems and villagers. Charmed plants will be in the zombie group, and Charmed zombies will be in the plant group.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.intro.group.group3.te: The zombie group will actively attack creatures in the plant and other guard groups, and will passively attack other hostile and neutral creatures. The plant group will actively attack creatures from the zombie and other hostile groups, while passively attacking other guards and neutral creatures.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.intro.group.name: Group
Maybe you haven't encountered zombies yet, but it doesn't mean that there are no zombies. Strange help didn't lie to you. From the beginning of the creation of the world, there is a SafeDayLength. The default SafeDayLength is 4 game days, after which invasion will occur every 2 day in OverWorld. they can be modified in the config file.
Invasions are based on days. If there is a sign <Zombies are coming> in the morning, it means that the invasion has begun and it will continue until the end of the day. Zombie Invasion contains various of events, Events can divided into two types (Spawn Events, Assist Events).
Overworld will spawn various of zombies in that day. There is only one Spawn Events in each Invasion day, it determines what kind of zombies will spawn in Overworld. there may be also some Assist events, which can enhance zombies or change the environment.
when invasion start, you will see a invasion progress in the lower right corner, it will tip you when will wave start. The higher the TreeLevel is, the more waves player may encounter. You will see <A huge wave of zombies are coming> when wave is spawned. some zombie invasion teams will spawn surround players in 48 blocks, If you dislike the waves, you can turn off in config file.
Every Invasion day will randomly give mission to players, including kill invaders, collect sun, instant kill. All Mission have several stage, finish each of stage will get rewards like Money, Jewel, Lottery Chance.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.intro.invade.name: Zombie Invade
book.pvz.pvz_guide.intro.name: PVZ Intro
book.pvz.pvz_guide.intro.plants.name: Plants
Plants are creatures that are hostile to zombies and all kinds of monsters. Different plants have different usages. Some can produce sun, such as SunFlowers. Some can attack enemies, such as PeaShooters. Some can defend, such as NutWalls.
Plants are relatively fragile. Terrestrial plants can only survive on grass blocks and Water lilies and golden tiles and flower pots, while aquatic plants can only survive in water.
Both plants and zombies have qualities. The qualities are gray, white, green, blue, purple, gold, red, black and mega, which become higher from left to right. The higher the quality, the stronger the corresponding plants or zombies. More experience gained from killing high-quality zombies. For plants, the higher the quality, the more difficult it is to get.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.intro.player_resource: Plants vs Zombies mod added some player resources, including TreeLevel, SunNum, EnergyNum and so on. If you didn't change the config file, you will see 2 strange gui on the corner of the screen in game, which are related to the player resources.

Before explaining them, you should know The Tree of Wisdom first. The Tree of Wisdom is not a common tree, it's invisible and intangible and it rooted in player's soul and integrated with the player. In the world of PVZ, The Tree of Wisdom can help players collect and store resources such as sun and energy and fight side by side with players.

Tree Level: It is independent of the default mc level, can also be called the PVZ Level. Usage: The higher the level is, the higher upper limit of SunNum and the more card you can use. Display: The upper left corner of the screen or command to view. Upgrade method: player or its plants kill zombies can gain some xp (Except for the zombies not belong to pvzmod).

SunNum: The upper limit of SunNum will increase when TreeLevel increases. Usage: Using Summon Cards and some tools will consume SunNum. Display: The upper left corner of the screen or command to view. Obtaining method: collide with Sun entity or use Resource Collector or eat SunStorageSapling.

EnergyNum: the upper limit of energy beans can be bought from Crazy Dave. Usage: player using sword enchanted with energy transfer right click plant will make plant in super mode and consume energy. Display: The lower left corner of the screen or command to view. Obtaining method: collide with Energy entity or use Resource Collector.

Money: the general currency of shops, its upper limit is 1000000. Usage: purchase some Upgrade Plant Cards and tools. Display: The upper left corner of the screen or command. Obtaining method: collide with Coin entity or use Resource Collector.

GemNum: the special currency of shops, its upper limit is 1000000. Usage: purchase some Plant Enjoy Cards and special tools. Display: The upper left corner of the screen or command. Obtaining method: collide with Jewel entity or use Resource Collector.

Tips: you can use command /playerstats to change or query your resource. If you can't see jewel num or money or tree level on the upper left corner, please press key (left <- or -> right) to toggle display.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.intro.zombies.name: Zombie
book.pvz.pvz_guide.intro.zombies.zombies: Zombies are crazy creatures that feed on brains. They are enemies with plants and also attack players and Crazy Dave. There are many types of zombies, some can walk on the road; some can drive a car, some can dive in the sea, there are even zombies that can ride a dolphin.

There are various rewards for killing zombies, players can get TreeXp when they and their plants kill zombies. Zombies have chances to drop Coins(silver coins, gold coins), Gems, Chocolate, plant seeds, origin essence and so on. If you kill a zombie surrounded by green light, it will definitely drop Energy. If you kill a zombie surrounded by yellow light, it will definitely drop Sun.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.name: PVZ Guide
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.description: I believe that through reading the introduction, you have probably understood what the world of PVZ is like. Next, let us embark on the journey and start the adventure!
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.enchant.enchant: When PlantCards have Break Out Enchantment, every time the card summons a plant, it will give the plant a chance to be super mode. Its max lvl is 4, **5% for lvl 1, 7.5% for 2, 10% for 3, and 12.5% for lvl 4**.
When Swords have Energy Transfer Enchantment, Players can right click plants to consume energy num and make plants in super mode. Its max lvl is 1.
When PlantCards have Charm Enchantment, The plant summoned will be charmed and attack its owner. Its max lvl is 1.
When Shovels have Sun Shovel Enchantment, the plants it shoveled will give some sun back. Its max lvl is 5.
Similar to Mending, when tools have Sun Mending Enchantment, Player can fix their tools when collide with sun. Its max lvl is 3.
When PlantCards have Soilless Plant Enchantment, the plants summoned are able to survive on every block. Its max lvl is 1.
When PlantCards have Densely Plant Enchantment, it can place 10 more each level before reach count limit.
When PlantCards have Immediate CD Enchantment, card have chance to only have 1 second cool down.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.enchant.name: Enchantments
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.essence.essence: Everything has its **origin**, plants and zombies are no exception. Plants are derived from the special effects of **plant seeds and special essences**, and the special essences are derived from the Origin Essences. *The source of zombies is currently unknown*. The Origin Essence is **the origin of most special essences**. If you want to obtain it, you have to find the answer from the saplings.

During the growth of saplings, some saplings may absorb too much energy and overflow. Eventually, the saplings will fail to grow, and an Origin Ore full of energy will accumulate in the dirt below the saplings. Use a **Diamond-level Pickaxe** to dig the Origin Ore to obtain a small amount of Origin Essences. You can also find some ores on the ground.

**Origin Essence** has a certain amount of **radioactivity**. It can radiate **plant seeds** and other items to make them alienate. However, a single original essence is not enough to obtain special essences, and they must be synthesized into Original Block with strong radiation.

Its radiation has no effect on creatures, but it will **radiate special blocks within 1 block around it as the corresponding Essence Ore**. Due to the instability of its radiation, the time when the surrounding squares are changed is also different.

The result of all special blocks after radiation: Grass Block / Lunar Stone / Redstone Block / Granite / Snow Block / Andesite are radiated into Appease Ore / Light Ore / Explosion Ore / Defence Ore / Ice Ore / Enforce Ore.
Mycelium / Diorite / Soul Sand / Magma Block / Gravel / Sandstone are radiated into Toxic Ore / Assist Ore / Magic Ore / Flame Ore / Spear Ore / Arma Ore.

There are **14 special essences** in total: **appease, light, explosion, defense, ice, enforce, toxic, assist, magic, flame, spear, arma, electric and shadow**. The first twelve are obtained by radiating the blocks listed above. Electric and Shadow have no radiating source block, so their essences can only be obtained from their own Essence Ores.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.essence.name: Essence
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.festival.festiv: **Version 0.2.3 of the Plants vs Zombies mod** updates Halloween-related content, adding a Halloween zombie invasion type. On the day of the Halloween invasion, trick zombies and pumpkin zombies will spawn. Killing them will has probability of dropping candy.
In general, Chocolate is difficult to obtain, but if you have Candy, you can directly craft it.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.festival.name: Festivals
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.name: PVZ Start
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.plant_card.name: Crafting Plant Card
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.plant_card.plan: Crafting Summon Cards generally need original materials, card templates, and corresponding special essences. The crafting materials can be **seeds, summoning cards**, etc. the card template is corresponding to the **quality** of the Summon Card. The special essence is generally the essence corresponding to the creature.

Crafting Card templates need Origin Essences and specific materials. Special essences was introduced earlier. The original materials are complicated, because different Summon Cards require different materials. Fortunately, a creature only corresponds to one essence. According to the recipe, just look for the ingredients.
Take PeaShooter Card as an example. PeaShooter is a creature with **gray quality and appease essence**. So its recipe requires **peas, gray card templates and Appease Essence.**
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.potion.name: Potions
Excite potion can make the player in an excited state, thereby reducing the cooldown of the plant card. **Each level of excitement will reduce CD by 10%**, and the tenth level of excitement can make plant cards have no CD. You can use chocolate to make Excite potions at the **brewing stand**.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.seed.name: Seed
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.seed.seed1.text: Peas may drop when you **break grass**. Peas can be planted like crops, and right click to harvest them when matured.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.seed.seed3.text: Nut trees grow in the Zen garden, and the nuts fall through the nut leaves.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.seed.seed4.text: Chompers grow in Zen Garden and are **very rare**. Fortunately, bone meal can make them grow.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.seed.seed5.text: Killing Lava zombies has a chance to drop peppers, you can find them in Nether.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.seed.seed6.text: Cabbage Seeds may drop when you **break grass**. They can be planted like crops.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.seed.seed7.text: Corn Seeds may drop when kill zombies. They can be planted like crops.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.seed.seed8.text: Trade with wander villager, they can be planted in place where sky light is 0. Right click can harvest.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.shop.name: Shop
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.shop.shop1.text:
Dave Villa is a structure generated in **Overworld plains**, where a Crazy Dave and Penny will be spawned. At the same time, the lawn of the villa may spawn some plants. Players can trade with Dave with Money, and Dave currently sells **Energy limits and almanac and some Upgrade Cards**.
Penny currently does not have AI and will be updated soon.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.shop.shop2.text: Dave Villa has a car named [Penny]. If you hold Car Key and right click to trade with gem, you can get Lawn Mower and many enjoy cards.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.shop.shop3.text: Sun Temple is a structure generated in **Desert Sky**, where a Sun Dave will spawn. Players can trade it with sun.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.shop.shop4.text: The trade list will update every 20 minutes.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.sun_storage.sun: Sun Storage Sapling is a kind of sapling that can storage sun for players. Players can **right click** to eat it and absorb its sun, and it will **not consume** after finish eating. Besides, it often used in machine at energy input slot.
Basic storage sapling, its max storage amount is 1000.
Normal storage sapling, its max storage amount is 3000.
Large storage sapling, its max storage amount is 10000.
Sun Converter can help Storage Saplings absorb sun, you just need to **put saplings into the 9 slots**, and the Converter will automatically absorb nearby sun and transfer to saplings.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.zen_garden.name: Zen Garden
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.zen_garden.zeng:
**Zen Garden** is a biome in **OverWorld**. It is a quiet and peaceful land where **no creatures will naturally spawn**.
There are 2 kinds of special plants: nut trees and chombers
[Other content is coming soon]
**Chompers** are very **rare**, so it will take a lot of effort to find them.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.start.zombie_house.zo: **Zombie House** is a structure generated in the world. There are currently Bucket, Dolphin and Grave Houses. Zombie Houses usually have chests for Enjoy Cards, but the reward is accompanied by danger. There is also a **spawner for zombies**, which is also a form of zombie spawning.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.tooltip: A guide to Plants vs Zombies
book.pvz.pvz_guide.weapon.description: Plants and Players progress together. Players train plants to upgrade. Plants will also give players the ability to use Plant weapons and tools. And the higher the plant level, the stronger the plant weapons and tools.
book.pvz.pvz_guide.weapon.name: Plant Weapons and Tools
book.pvz.pvz_guide.weapon.pea_gun.name: Pea Gun
book.pvz.pvz_guide.weapon.pea_gun.peagun: Pea Gun is a range-attack plant weapon that can fire peas. Right-click it in the **off hand** to open the backpack, in the **main hand** to fire peas, and **it can also be worn on the head and fired automatically**. It comes with a 27-cell ammunition backpack for peas and a card slot, which is used to put plant cards to **control the shooting mode** of Pea Gun.
Pea Gun
shoot forward four peas at a time
GatlingPea Mode
shoot five peas at a time in a star pattern, **72 degrees apart with a random starting angle**
StarFruit Mode
shoot five peas at a time in a star pattern, **72 degrees apart**
AngelStarFruit Mode

The fired pea type is decided by the **shooting mode** and the **ammunition** in the backpack: **normal Pea**, Ice Pea (from Snow Pea mode or ice pea ammo) and Flame Pea (from flame pea ammo). The fire cooldown is **30 ticks** by default and is shortened by the Quick Charge enchantment (20/15/10 ticks for lvl 1/2/3). Power enchantment adds **0.5** base damage per level (base 1.5). Tree level only slightly improves the no-consumption chance of the Infinity enchantment.
Shooting Type

**Pea Gun** can be enchanted with Power, Infinity, Quick Charge and Unbreaking. Power **increases the initial damage** of Pea. Infinity gives a **chance not to consume peas** (unlike a bow), and this chance is affected by the Tree Level. Quick Charge shortens the fire cooldown, while Unbreaking increases durability.
Enchantments
The recipe of Pea Gun needs **four peas, one dispenser, four Appease Essences and two Origin Ingots**.
Pea Gun Recipe
normal shoot style, shoot forward one pea at a time
PeaShooter Mode
normal shoot style, **no matter what kind of pea is in the ammunition backpack, the final shot out is snow peas.**
SnowPea Mode
shoot forward two peas at a time
Repeater Mode
shoot three peas forward at a time in a fan (-15/0/+15 degrees)
ThreePeater Mode
shoot forward one peas and shoot backward two peas at a time
SplitPea Mode
book.pvz.pvz_guide.weapon.resource_colle: Resource Collector is a tool used to collect various resources. **Normally aim at the entity and right click to collect it, or right click while shifting to collect a whole range of resource**.
